text.εσύ: Address the reader informally with «εσύ» (second person singular) everywhere, also in technical pages. Never use the formal «εσείς».

style.loanwords_text: Crypto loanwords (blockchain, token, swap, staking) stay in English; translate only where a common Greek term exists (κόμβος, έξυπνο συμβόλαιο). The terminology list below wins over this rule.
writing_rules: Thousands take a full stop and decimals a comma (1.000,5).
«Hub» (as in ZecHub, an education hub) is «κέντρο»: «αποκεντρωμένο κέντρο εκπαίδευσης». Never «κόμβος», which is reserved for a network node.

Greek word order for a name plus a noun: the noun first, then the name («Οδηγός νέου χρήστη Zcash», «Αναβαθμίσεις δικτύου του Zcash», «το αποθετήριο του ZecHub στο GitHub»), never «Zcash Οδηγός…» or «ZecHub αποθετήριο».
Headings and link text use sentence case, as Greek does: only the first word and names take a capital («Θωρακισμένα pools», «Πλήρεις κόμβοι»).
Post-quantum: «ανθεκτικός στους κβαντικούς υπολογιστές», never «μετά την κβαντική εποχή».
Oblivious sync (Tachyon): «τυφλός συγχρονισμός», like «τυφλές υπογραφές» for blind signatures.
A tutorial is «οδηγός» or, for a video, «βίντεο με οδηγίες»; never «σεμινάριο» (a seminar).
Calls to action use the imperative: «υπόβαλε ένα pull request», not the past tense «υπέβαλε».
Keep a space between a name and the next word inside link text («[Τεκμηρίωση του Zcash]»), never glue them.

wallet.context: A wallet in running text: «πορτοφόλι». Inside the device name "hardware wallet" the English stays (see hardware-wallet), and so does a product name such as «Brave Wallet».

shielded.notes: Agrees with the noun in use: θωρακισμένη διεύθυνση/συναλλαγή, θωρακισμένο pool.

proof.notes: «απόδειξη μηδενικής γνώσης» is the established Greek term in courses and articles.

node.notes: «κόμβος» is the standard Greek word for a network node; reads naturally to non-developers.

exchange.notes: Matches the menus and Greek apps, e.g. MetaMask «Εισηγμένο σε ανταλλακτήριο»: https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/6b79fa6210e16aad899edc570eae007028959472/app/_locales/el/messages.json#L9835

memo.notes: Matches the menu label «Σημειώματα»; keeps it distinct from «note», which stays English.

fee.notes: «τέλος» alone reads as «end»; wallets say «τέλη δικτύου», e.g. MetaMask in Greek: https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/6b79fa6210e16aad899edc570eae007028959472/app/_locales/el/messages.json#L1425

custodial.notes: Greek crypto media and apps say «custodial / non-custodial»; «θεματοφυλακτικό» sounds like legal text.

zero-knowledge.notes: Established Greek term («αποδείξεις μηδενικής γνώσης»); used as a genitive modifier.

network-upgrade.notes: Plain Greek, understood by everyone; NU5/NU6 names stay as they are.

mining.notes: «ναρκοθέτηση» means laying landmines; crypto mining is «εξόρυξη».

seed-phrase.notes: What Greek wallet apps show, e.g. MetaMask «Μυστική Φράση Ανάκτησης»: https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/6b79fa6210e16aad899edc570eae007028959472/app/_locales/el/messages.json#L2851

chain.context: The word chain on its own in a sentence: «αλυσίδα». The fixed terms on-chain and cross-chain stay English.

cross-chain.context: The fixed crypto term Greek readers use; not the word chain on its own (αλυσίδα).

visualizer.notes: Used as the tool's name in the menu; «εργαλείο οπτικοποίησης» is too long for a label.

brand.notes: «brand» is the usual word for logos and visual identity in Greek; matches the menu label.

top-up.notes: «ανανεώστε» is a command («renew!»); the term is «ανανέωση» (ανανέωση κινητού), as in the menu.

newsletter.notes: «newsletter» is what Greek sites and readers use; matches the menu label.

address.notes: «προσφώνηση» means a form of address/greeting; a wallet address is «διεύθυνση».

block.context: A block of the chain in running text: «μπλοκ». The tool name "block explorer" stays English.

signature.notes: Context already makes it cryptographic; «κρυπτογραφική υπογραφή» is too long for every use.

on-chain.context: The fixed crypto term Greek readers use; not the word chain on its own (αλυσίδα).

bridge.notes: «μπριτζ» is a transliteration nobody uses; Greek crypto media say «γέφυρα».

smart-contract.notes: Established Greek term, used in Greek press and law texts.

permissionless.notes: «χωρίς άδεια» can read as «unlicensed / illegal»; this keeps the meaning «no approval needed».

hardware-wallet.context: The physical signing device: Greek users say and search for «hardware wallet». Not the software wallet (πορτοφόλι).

Akash Network Zebra.notes: Same wording as the guides menu «Δίκτυο Akash».

Block Explorers.context: The tool name stays English, like the reviewer's on-chain and hardware wallet; a block on its own is «μπλοκ».

CoinHolder Directed Retroactive Grants.target: Αναδρομικές επιχορηγήσεις με ψήφο κατόχων ZEC
CoinHolder Directed Retroactive Grants.notes: «κατόχων coin» is half English; coinholders direct the grants by vote.

Community Links.notes: «Κρίκοι» are chain links; web links are «σύνδεσμοι».

Custodial Exchanges.notes: Glossary: custodial stays English, exchange → ανταλλακτήριο.

Ecosystem.context: The menu label on its own (nominative). In a phrase Greek changes the ending: «οικοσυστήματος» (see Zcash Ecosystem Security).

Migration Guide Zcashd To Zebrad Zallet.target: Οδηγός μετάβασης από Zcashd σε Zebrad και Zallet

rejected.text: Οδηγός μετάβασης από Zcashd σε Zebrad Zallet

Migration Guide Zcashd To Zebrad Zallet.notes: Two separate programs, so «και» is needed.

rejected.text: Το πρώτο μου βιβλίο εργασίας για το Zcash

My First Zcash Workbook.notes: A school workbook is «τετράδιο» in Greek; «βιβλίο εργασίας» sounds translated.

Places to Spend ZEC.notes: Natural Greek; «Μέρη για δαπάνη» reads like a translation.

Shielded Pools.notes: Glossary: shielded → θωρακισμένο, pool stays English.

Spend Zcash.notes: «Δαπάνη» sounds like an accounting expense; informal imperative like the rest of the site.

Transparent Exchange Addresses.notes: Glossary: transparent → διαφανές; no half-English label. Glossary: transparent → διαφανές.

Use Zcash.notes: Header bar: same meaning without the article, as short as «Οικοσύστημα».

Using ZEC Privately.notes: «Ιδιωτικοποίηση» means privatisation; matches the top menu label.

Zallet Quick Reference Guide.target: Σύντομος οδηγός αναφοράς για το Zallet

Zcash Ecosystem Security.context: Same word as Ecosystem, in the genitive (οικοσυστήματος) as Greek grammar requires.

Zero Knowledge vs Decoy Systems.notes: Glossary: zero-knowledge in Greek; «δολώματα» is the Greek word for decoys.

Zero-Knowledge vs Decoys.notes: Same as the guides menu label.

Brave Wallet Guide.notes: Brave Wallet is the product's name, so it stays English.
Brave Wallet Guide.context: Brave Wallet is a product name (protected), so «Wallet» stays English here; a wallet in running text is «πορτοφόλι».

Viewing Key Transaction Export.notes: Glossary: viewing key stays English in lowercase. «συναλλαγών» is συναλλαγή in the plural genitive.

changelog.summary: Greek native review by @panoskokmotos (Translation Quality bounty, stage 1, #2489): the deliberate splits wallet/hardware wallet and chain/on-chain/cross-chain the case ending of Ecosystem and the tool name Block explorers, with contexts; Greek case and plural forms added by the steward so menu phrases match their terms; style answers (εσύ, «» quotes, decimal comma, western digits, English in brackets on first use).

changelog.summary: Greek stage 2 review by @panoskokmotos (#2427, follow-up menus #2508): English in brackets set to never; writing rules for hub, word order, sentence case, post-quantum, oblivious sync, tutorial, imperative calls to action and link text; the follow-up menu labels (new website strings, language menu, shorter «Χρήση Zcash» for the header bar); transaction plural forms and the Brave Wallet product-name context added by the steward so the follow-up phrases pass rule 3.
